plugins.name: agentic-scaffold
plugins.description: session-closeout is current; init, nest, logchange and repo-audit are out of date against current conventions (2026-11-09), so do not rely on them to scaffold projects for others. Scaffold agentic best practices into any repo. Generates AGENTS.md as the canonical instruction file, a CLAUDE.md compatibility wrapper, README.md, CHANGELOG.md, DECISIONS.md, ROADMAP.md, and adaptive editor configs.
